description: Release-readiness ledger for the two production-held transition projects: nirs4all Python and nirs4all Studio.

policy.legacy_reader_scope: Only the Python nirs4all transition line and nirs4all Studio carry legacy workspace/artifact reader and converter support. Other V1 language/package surfaces consume the new workspace format only.
policy.full_parity_policy: Fresh full parity gates are required after large selected-head changes; do not rerun them for documentation-only changes unless a gate selects those docs as release evidence.

covers: full pytest plus coverage on Ubuntu 3.11 and 3.13
full pytest plus coverage on Windows 3.11 and 3.13
full pytest plus coverage on macOS 3.13
Studio CI gate on current main after RC4 documentation refresh
Studio browser E2E gate on current main after RC4 documentation refresh

required_capabilities: public backend option can request legacy or dag-ml execution where implemented
legacy and V1 workspace formats are detected
legacy workspace/artifact warnings include the concrete conversion command
nirs4all[transition] pulls the converter dependencies needed for legacy DuckDB/Parquet inputs
old scripts remain compatible during the transition window
manual_release_steps: choose and stamp the transition version
merge or fast-forward the selected transition branch only after reviewing the held-project policy
publish the transition package after confirming the current automated gate evidence is still selected

required_capabilities: global backend preference is visible in Studio settings
experiment, pipeline-editor, training, and AutoML paths preserve requested and actual runtime metadata
legacy workspace warning is visible at workspace open and in workspace settings
clean conversions can link and activate the converted workspace
installer artifacts are available for manual Windows smoke testing
manual_release_steps: run native Windows smoke against the RC4 installer artifacts
confirm user workspace conversion behavior manually on a legacy workspace copy
only then decide whether to cut a production Studio transition release

evidence_required: legacy workspace warning appears for a copied legacy workspace
conversion action writes a sibling V1 workspace without deleting the source
selected Python transition version is chosen
selected Studio transition version is chosen
Python branch and Studio main are explicitly approved as release heads
manual Windows RC smoke evidence is attached or waived with a recorded rationale

completion_state.reason: Automated gates are green, but held-project manual gates remain pending.
